gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Press Start 2P spaces its pixel-bright letters far apart, like cut-outs pinned to a board, with only a faint stroke variation. Noto Sans Lisu follows as a plain sans with wide s curves, so try it a size or two below the heading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Pinned-up pixels, playful and retro. Noto Sans Lydian is the sans-serif counterweight, its capitals barely above the lowercase and its openings wide, so paragraphs would flow along smoothly and without fuss.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Retro arcade fun, spaced like cut-outs. Noto Sans Mahajani brings a plain sans with tall lowercase and funnel-wide e shapes, which gives Press Start 2P a sleek, modern partner to sit beside.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-malayala: Noto Sans Malayalam keeps the middle of each line dense, with generous bends in its s, and that gives a sturdy base. Press Start 2P then hangs above it, retro and widely spaced, with barely any brush-like swell.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic has curvy lowercase that rises close to the capitals, loose and unclamped. Noto Sans Mandaic's sans lines then sit under Press Start 2P, whose thin strokes are hairline-free beside moderately weighty stems.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen stands its small letters up proud, nearly capital-sized. Press Start 2P adds its fun, retro, pinned-apart spacing on top, and that spread between its lightest and heaviest parts is only middling.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nu: Chunky, retro and loose-spaced. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals has tall-bodied small letters and a gaping c, so give it a little more size than you'd expect, and Press Start 2P will stay playful above.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-medefaid: Playful and retro, all the way down. Noto Sans Medefaidrin rises high in its lowercase with no ink pooling in the turns, while Press Start 2P keeps a faint wedge of pen pressure in its curves.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-meetei-m: Contemporary and a bit cracked-open. Press Start 2P is best at fun, retro, far-apart lettering with a faint rubbery weight shift, while Noto Sans Meetei Mayek does the quieter job with its large lowercase and gapped rounds.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mende-ki: Press Start 2P brings retro fun, with a mild taper like wire rolled barely flat. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui does the steadier job as a plain sans, with daylight through every curve and lowercase that stands tall.
